info.name: Services Mobile API v1
info.description:
# Services Mobile API (v1)

Source of truth: `routes/api.php` under `/api/v1`.

## Apps
- **Customer app**: register/login + home, catalog, orders, notifications, addresses
- **Technician app**: login only (no register; created from Platform/Company admin), offers, order status, items
- **Public**: banners, companies, CMS pages (no auth)

## Auth
- Laravel Sanctum Bearer token
- Customer login/register returns `{ token, token_type: "Bearer", user, customer }`
- Technician login returns `{ token, token_type: "Bearer", user, technician }`
- Protected routes: `Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}` or `{{technician_token}}`

## Locale
- Query `?locale=ar|en` or header `Accept-Language: {{locale}}`
- Middleware: `SetApiLocale`

## Response shape
- API Resources typically have **no** top-level `data` wrapper (`JsonResource::withoutWrapping`)
- Paginated lists may still use Laravel pagination keys (`data`, `links`, `meta`) depending on endpoint

## Typical customer flow
1. POST /customer/register or /login → save token
2. GET /customer/home
3. GET /service-categories → problems → intake-fields
4. GET /available-technicians?service_category_id=
5. POST /addresses (if needed)
6. POST /orders
7. Pay placeholders / invoice

## Typical technician flow
1. POST /technician/login → save token
2. PATCH /availability, PATCH /location
3. GET /order-offers → accept/reject
4. PATCH /orders/{id}/status + manage items

## Controllers
`app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/{Public,Customer,Technician}/`

item.name: Public
item.description: No auth. Home ads, companies browse, CMS pages.

request.description: Active home-screen ads/slider within schedule window. Fields: title, subtitle, cta_label, image_url, link_type (none|url|category|company|screen), link_value, sort_order.
Active companies. Query: q (search), category_id, sort=featured|name|offers. Includes is_featured, logo_url, offer_text when discounts loaded.
Company details + active discounts/offer_text.
Approved active portfolio projects (paginated).
Public content page by slug. Default env page_slug=guarantees. Returns title/body localized fields.

item.name: Customer / Auth
item.description: Customer registration & Sanctum session. Login/Register tests auto-save customer_token.

request.description: Creates user+customer. Body: name, email, phone?, password, password_confirmation. Response 201: token, token_type, user, customer.
Customer-only login. Revokes prior tokens. Body: email, password, device_name?. Saves customer_token.
Not implemented — returns 501. Providers planned: google, apple.
Current customer profile + unread_notifications_count.
Partial update: name, name_ar, name_en, phone, email. Sending name without name_ar syncs name_ar.
Deletes current access token.

item.name: Customer / Home & Search
item.description: Home aggregate matches Figma home screen.

request.description: Aggregate: user, greeting_name, current_location (default address), categories, banners, featured_companies, unread_notifications_count.
Required q. Returns categories, companies, technicians (approved+active).
Paginated inbox. Additional unread_count. Items: id, type, title, body, data, read_at, created_at.
Mark single database notification as read.
Mark all unread notifications as read.
Required: lat, lng. Optional Kuwait-style fields: area, block, street, building, floor, apartment, label, contact_*, full_address, is_default.

item.name: Customer / Catalog
item.description: Service categories → problems → intake fields → available technicians.

request.description: Active categories with icon_path/icon_url, localized names.
Problems for choose-service screen.
Extra intake questions for order creation.
Required service_category_id. Optional lat,lng for distance sort. Only available approved technicians with coordinates.
Required: technician_id, customer_address_id, service_category_id. Optional: service_problem_id, custom_problem_text, customer_notes, intake_answers[]. Creates inspection payment placeholder.
Placeholder payment flow for inspection fee.
Placeholder final payment after work.
